# The Tax Adviser

> > The Tax Adviser is AICPA's authoritative resource for federal tax planning, IRS guidance, and professional tax practice insights covering individuals, corporations, and pass-through entities.

The Tax Adviser is AICPA's premier tax publication delivering comprehensive coverage of individual income taxation, corporate taxation, and pass-through entity structures. The site provides practical guidance on tax credits, deductions, compliance requirements, and emerging tax law changes including recent legislative updates like the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

## Key Topics

- Individual Income Tax
- Pass-Through Entities
- S Corporation Taxation
- Partnership & LLC Taxation
- Tax Credits & Deductions
- IRS Guidance
- Tax Compliance
- Qualified Business Income (Section 199A)
- Tax Forms & Reporting
- TEFRA Partnership Rules
- Economic Substance Doctrine
- Tax Court Rulings
- Business Interest Limitation
- Qualified Tips & Overtime Deductions
- Corporate Tax Planning

## Individual Income Taxation

- [Individual Income Taxation](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/individual): Main topic hub for individual income tax including deductions, credits, and forms
- [Individual Income Tax Credits](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/individual/credits): Guide to tax credits including earned income, child tax, and clean vehicle credits
- [Individual Income Tax Deductions](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/individual/expenses-deductions): Reference for individual deductions, business expenses, and qualified business income
- [Individual Income Tax](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/individual/income): Guide to taxable income, exclusions, and IRS income tax treatment rules
- [Individual Income Tax - Specialized Issues](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/individual/specialized-issues): Coverage of specialized individual tax topics including real estate and disaster relief

## Pass-Through Entity Taxation

- [S Corporation, Partnership & LLC Taxation](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/passthroughs): Main topic hub for pass-through entity taxation including S corps and LLCs
- [S Corporation Income Taxation](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/passthroughs/s-corporations): Guide to S corporation taxation, elections, and corporate tax planning strategies
- [Partnership and LLC Taxation](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/passthroughs/partnerships): Reference for partnership and LLC taxation including distributions and compliance
- [S Corporations, Partnerships & LLCs - Contributions, Distributions & Basis](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/passthroughs/basis): Guide to basis computation and distributions for pass-through entities
- [S Corporations, Partnerships & LLCs - Reporting & Filing Requirements](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/passthroughs/reporting-filing-requirements): Reference for pass-through entity tax reporting and IRS filing requirements

## Corporate Taxation

- [C Corporation Income Taxation](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/topics/corporation): Main topic hub for C corporation taxation and corporate tax planning

- [New Schedule 1-A for tips, OT, car loans, and senior deductions published](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/news/2026/mar/new-schedule-1-a-for-tips-ot-car-loans-and-seniors-deductions-published): News on IRS-published Schedule 1-A with tips and overtime deduction details
- [Prop. regs. issued on new qualified tips deduction](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/issues/2026/jan/prop-regs-issued-on-new-qualified-tips-deduction): Analysis of IRS proposed regulations on qualified tips deduction eligibility
- [IRS releases FAQs on qualified overtime pay deduction under H.R. 1](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/news/2026/jan/irs-releases-faqs-on-qualified-overtime-pay-deduction-under-h-r-1): IRS FAQs explaining qualified overtime pay deduction rules under H.R. 1

## Tax Planning & Compliance Issues

- [Partner redemptions from 'dry' partnerships](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/issues/2026/feb/partner-redemptions-from-dry-partnerships): Article on partner redemptions from partnerships holding corporate stock
- [Death of an LLC member: Basic tax considerations](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/issues/2026/feb/death-of-an-llc-member-basic-tax-considerations): Guide to LLC member death tax implications and succession planning
- [Penalties under codified economic substance doctrine upheld](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/issues/2026/feb/penalties-under-codified-economic-substance-doctrine-upheld): Tax Court ruling on economic substance doctrine penalties for invalid transactions
- [TEFRA petition filing deadline is jurisdictional](https://www.thetaxadviser.com/issues/2026/jan/tefra-petition-filing-deadline-is-jurisdictional): Tax Court decision on TEFRA partnership petition filing deadline jurisdiction
